title: "2 Corinthians"
---

# 2 Corinthians

::: {.book-summary}
## Book Summary Insight

2 Corinthians reveals Paul's heart as a pastor and apostle while defending his ministry. The book teaches that God's power is displayed through human weakness, His grace sustains believers through suffering, and Christians are called to live as transformed ambassadors of reconciliation.
:::

::: {.chapter-entry}
## Chapter 1

<div class="key-verse">2 Corinthians 1:3</div>

<div class="identifier">The Father of mercies and God of all comfort</div>

### Why This Verse

Comfort in affliction

### Chapter Insight

This chapter emphasizes God's comfort in suffering and Paul's integrity in ministry. The key verse reveals that God comforts believers so they can comfort others.
:::

::: {.chapter-entry}
## Chapter 2

<div class="key-verse">2 Corinthians 2:14</div>

<div class="identifier">Thanks be unto God, which always causes us to triumph</div>

### Why This Verse

Victory in Christ

### Chapter Insight

This chapter encourages forgiveness and restoration within the church. The key verse highlights the importance of extending grace to repentant believers.
:::

::: {.chapter-entry}
## Chapter 3

<div class="key-verse">2 Corinthians 3:17</div>

<div class="identifier">Where the Spirit of the Lord is, there is liberty</div>

### Why This Verse

One of the most quoted Pauline verses

### Chapter Insight

This chapter contrasts the Old Covenant and the New Covenant. The key verse teaches that transformation comes through the Spirit of the Lord.
:::

::: {.chapter-entry}
## Chapter 4

<div class="key-verse">2 Corinthians 4:18</div>

<div class="identifier">Look not at the things which are seen</div>

### Why This Verse

Eternal perspective

### Chapter Insight

This chapter focuses on perseverance in ministry despite hardship. The key verse emphasizes that temporary afflictions produce eternal glory.
:::

::: {.chapter-entry}
## Chapter 5

<div class="key-verse">2 Corinthians 5:17</div>

<div class="identifier">If any man be in Christ, he is a new creature</div>

### Why This Verse

One of the most cited verses in the NT

### Chapter Insight

This chapter discusses eternal hope and the ministry of reconciliation. The key verse declares that anyone in Christ is a new creation.
:::

::: {.chapter-entry}
## Chapter 6

<div class="key-verse">2 Corinthians 6:2</div>

<div class="identifier">Now is the accepted time</div>

### Why This Verse

Salvation appeal

### Chapter Insight

This chapter calls believers to wholehearted devotion and separation from sinful influences. The key verse urges Christians not to receive God's grace in vain.
:::

::: {.chapter-entry}
## Chapter 7

<div class="key-verse">2 Corinthians 7:10</div>

<div class="identifier">Godly sorrow worketh repentance</div>

### Why This Verse

Repentance defined

### Chapter Insight

This chapter highlights godly sorrow that leads to repentance. The key verse contrasts worldly grief with repentance that brings life.
:::

::: {.chapter-entry}
## Chapter 8

<div class="key-verse">2 Corinthians 8:9</div>

<div class="identifier">Though He was rich, yet for your sakes He became poor</div>

### Why This Verse

Grace and generosity

### Chapter Insight

This chapter encourages generous giving through the example of Christ and the Macedonian churches. The key verse emphasizes sacrificial generosity motivated by grace.
:::

::: {.chapter-entry}
## Chapter 9

<div class="key-verse">2 Corinthians 9:7</div>

<div class="identifier">God loveth a cheerful giver</div>

### Why This Verse

Giving

### Chapter Insight

This chapter continues the teaching on giving. The key verse teaches that God loves a cheerful giver.
:::

::: {.chapter-entry}
## Chapter 10

<div class="key-verse">2 Corinthians 10:5</div>

<div class="identifier">Bringing into captivity every thought</div>

### Why This Verse

Spiritual warfare

### Chapter Insight

This chapter defends Paul's apostolic authority. The key verse reminds believers that spiritual battles are fought with spiritual weapons.
:::

::: {.chapter-entry}
## Chapter 11

<div class="key-verse">2 Corinthians 11:14</div>

<div class="identifier">Satan himself is transformed into an angel of light</div>

### Why This Verse

Discernment

### Chapter Insight

This chapter warns against false apostles and recounts Paul's sufferings. The key verse highlights Paul's willingness to endure hardship for Christ.
:::

::: {.chapter-entry}
## Chapter 12

<div class="key-verse">2 Corinthians 12:9</div>

<div class="identifier">My grace is sufficient for thee</div>

### Why This Verse

One of Paul's most beloved verses

### Chapter Insight

This chapter records Paul's vision and the thorn in the flesh. The key verse teaches that God's grace is sufficient and His power is perfected in weakness.
:::

::: {.chapter-entry}
## Chapter 13

<div class="key-verse">2 Corinthians 13:14</div>

<div class="identifier">The grace of the Lord Jesus Christ</div>

### Why This Verse

Classic apostolic benediction

### Chapter Insight

This chapter concludes with final exhortations and blessings. The key verse calls believers to examine themselves and pursue spiritual maturity.
:::
